description: A negated formula is satisfied exactly when its body is not satisfied.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.realize_not.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  {α : Type u'} {l : ℕ} {φ : L.BoundedFormula α l} {v : α → M} {xs : Fin l → M} : φ.not.Realize v xs ↔ ¬φ.Realize v xs
